consent.admin: The server administrator can technically read the database. The protection is designed for the case of a data leak, not for distrust of the administrator.
consent.deletion: You can delete your account at any time: the data is removed from the database immediately and completely, and from backups by rotation, within 14 days at most.
consent.inference: A determined member who keeps changing their own answers and watching the feed can infer something about other people’s preferences. Daily limits slow this down but cannot prevent it.
consent.intro: OhMyMatch matches people based on bdsmtest.org results. The app is pseudonymous, not anonymous: we store only what matching and login cannot work without.
consent.not_stored: screenshots, the original result text, the result link, email, phone, name, photos, or IP addresses in the database.
consent.others: Other users never see your percentages, roles or “no” list, only your nickname and the shared axes you matched on.
consent.stored: a generated nickname, a hash of the password and a hash of the recovery code, “who I am” and “who I am looking for”, the search mode, the 25 percentages from the test, the “no” list, your reactions and matches, the version and time of this consent, the time of the 18+ confirmation and the account creation date.
consent.title: What we store and why

privacy.backups: The database is backed up, and every copy is encrypted (age) on the server before it is stored or sent anywhere; the decryption key is kept separately. Copies older than {days} days are deleted.
privacy.cookies: Only three cookies, all limited to this site: the login session, a token that protects forms, and the language choice. No analytics, trackers, third-party scripts or fonts.
privacy.deletion: In Settings, confirm with your password. The account and everything linked to it are deleted from the database immediately, all sessions end, and the data disappears from backups by rotation within {days} days.
privacy.inference: The feed reacts to your own profile, result and “no” list. A determined member who changes these again and again and watches who appears in or disappears from their feed can infer something about other people’s preferences. Daily limits on changes and feed pages slow this down but cannot prevent it.
privacy.inference_title: What a determined member can find out
privacy.intro: OhMyMatch is pseudonymous, not anonymous. Preferences, gender and whom you look for are special-category personal data, so we store only what matching and login cannot work without. This page describes what the system really does.
privacy.logs: The application log contains only the event type and a random request identifier. The web server’s access log records the IP address, time, method, page path (without query parameters), status and size, and is kept for at most {days} days.
privacy.memory: To slow down password guessing and scraping, the server counts requests per IP address, per nickname and per account. The counters hold only a keyed hash, live in memory for at most 24 hours, are never written to disk and are lost on restart.
privacy.not_stored: Screenshots, the pasted result text, the result link, email, phone, name, photos, free text and IP addresses are not in the database. Screenshots exist only in memory while they are recognised and are discarded right after.
privacy.stored_account: Account: the generated nickname, a hash of the password and a hash of the recovery code (argon2id), the creation date, the consent version and time, and the time of the 18+ confirmation.
privacy.stored_dislikes: The “no” list: the categories you marked.
privacy.stored_invites: Invites: a hash of the code, its expiry, and which account used it and when.
privacy.stored_profile: Profile: who you are, who you are looking for, the search mode, and whether the profile is complete.
privacy.stored_reactions: Reactions and matches: your likes, skips and hides with the time of each reaction, and your matches with their date.
privacy.stored_result: Test result: the 25 percentages you confirmed and when they were last changed.
privacy.stored_sessions: Sessions: an identifier derived from your login cookie and its expiry ({days} days). The cookie value itself is not stored.
privacy.stored_title: What is stored in the database
privacy.title: What we store
privacy.visibility: Other users see only your nickname and the names of the axes you matched on. Through the app nobody, including the administrator, sees other people’s percentages, roles or “no” lists. In a match, both people see each other’s nickname.
